mapper.select: SELECT i.id, i.name, i.description, i.category, i.rarity, i.price, i.discount_rate, i.image_url, i.purchasable, i.created_at, (usi.id IS NOT NULL) AS owned FROM shop_items i LEFT JOIN user_shop_items usi ON usi.item_id = i.id AND usi.user_id = #{userId} WHERE (#{category} IS NULL OR i.category = #{category}) AND (#{rarity} IS NULL OR i.rarity = #{rarity}) ORDER BY i.rarity ASC, i.price ASC, i.id ASC

SELECT i.id, i.name, i.description, i.category, i.rarity, i.price, i.discount_rate, i.image_url, i.purchasable, i.created_at, TRUE AS owned FROM user_shop_items usi JOIN shop_items i ON i.id = usi.item_id WHERE usi.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY usi.purchased_at DESC
SELECT id, name, description, category, rarity, price, discount_rate, image_url, purchasable, created_at, FALSE AS owned FROM shop_items WHERE id = #{itemId}
SELECT user_id, gold_balance FROM user_wallets WHERE user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT user_id, gold_balance FROM user_wallets WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO user_wallets (user_id, gold_balance) VALUES (#{userId}, #{goldBalance})
mapper.update: UPDATE user_wallets SET gold_balance = #{goldBalance} WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM user_shop_items WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND item_id = #{itemId})
